protocol.inputScope: contiguous M15 windows within NY PRE 04:00 through POST 20:00; early close days end POST 17:00
protocol.target: RTH geometry only; PRE=current RTH opening, RTH=unobserved remaining bars, POST=next trading-day RTH opening
protocol.clockMatch: same New York minute, phase and effective target length
protocol.outOfSample: last 40% of target days, one forecast per RTH day; candidates fully complete before input start
protocol.featureHistory: Strength and WLR retain original causal chart warm-up, which may include NIGHT bars; sample windows exclude NIGHT
protocol.limitations: Rule-defined geometry families and conditional analog frequencies are exploratory; not calibrated trading win probabilities. V1 aeon/ensemble has a different 3-bar target and is not combined with these six RTH labels.

outOfSample.method: paired 5-day moving-block bootstrap; positive favors conditional analogs
